result:
Round 297's task is written: a test-only fix for STUDIO-LINK-a, the "Try it in the Studio" product-page link. **Decision: CONTINUE.** No app source was touched; the store tree is clean.

**Round 296 result.** C passed STUDIO-LINK-a: 15 rows passed and 1 failed, with `browserVerified` and `realVerified` both true. The failed row was the screen budget. The sidebar grew 37.6 px against my limit of 32 px, but my number was wrong: I measured the link box instead of its whole line. Nothing else moved, so I closed it (C-R296-01). Gate 296 published `bc9d9a7` on both remotes, and that is the baseline for round 297. STUDIO-LINK-a is now marked done (მზადაა).

**Round 297 (STUDIO-LINK-a2).** A's code-reviewer left two Medium findings, and the bug gate fixes Mediums before new scope:
- removing the line that passes the preview id into the Studio changes no test, because that source is already first in the library;
- the server-render-then-hydrate path, which a real cold load uses, has no unit test.

A adds one new test file, copied byte for byte from my pre-run version, plus a few lines in doc 220. That is 2 file grants and no app code. The tests flip the demo library order so the preview is no longer first, and run every case through the real hydrate path.

On a scratch copy of `bc9d9a7`:
- the 6 covering test files (58 tests) pass, typecheck is clean and Biome reports nothing;
- removing the prop turns two of the new tests red, and so does removing the run-once guard;
- removing the narrow-window check changes nothing. That check can never fire: on a narrow window the workspace isn't mounted when it runs. So it is recorded as an equivalent mutant, not a test gap.

C reruns all of this and does one real-browser cold load of the deep link at both viewports, plus the anonymous-access check.

**Other rulings:**
- **No focus ring after a mouse click (C-R296-02, Low):** deferred, and added as question 4 for Saba under SABA-Q-STUDIO-LINK. In Chromium 143 a script can't force the focus ring after a mouse click, so a fix would need a second focus style. That conflicts with the one shared focus style Saba approved (SABA-B-4).
- **Gate reviewer suggestions:** the link reaching the narrow-screen page on phones, and the missing prefetch, are deferred Lows. Escaping the source id becomes a prerequisite for the later dynamic-preview version. What happens when `?preview=` changes on an open page becomes a decision row in STUDIO-LINK-b.
- **Architecture:** the route finds library elements by attribute. That is recorded as a backlog signal, "keep for now", and becomes input to a frontend-architect checkpoint at the end of this review stage.

**Next.** If round 298 is planned on or after 2026-11-02, it is the regression round. Otherwise the order is:
1. STUDIO-LINK-b (round 298)
2. NAME-AND-HINT
3. STUDIO-PERFORMANCE
4. STEM-LANES
5. SYS-1…3
6. STORE-2b…5

The RETRO is at round 305. I didn't call COMPLETE because most queued scope and every deferred Low remain. Nothing is BLOCKED, since nothing external is missing.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice. It corrected my round-296 row count (14 → 15) and one expected test result in C's acceptance rows; both are fixed. No project agents were consulted, because a test-only round doesn't need them.
